pairs: Tunc simile erit regnum cælorum decem virginibus:
“Then the kingdom of heaven shall be like ten virgins,
quæ accipientes lampades suas exierunt obviam sponso et sponsæ.
who, taking their lamps, went out to meet the groom and the bride.
Quinque autem ex eis erant fatuæ,
But five of them were foolish,
did not take oil with them.
prudentes vero acceperunt oleum in vasis suis cum lampadibus.
Yet truly, the prudent ones brought the oil, in their containers, with the lamps.
Media autem nocte clamor factus est:
But in the middle of the night, a cry went out:
Then all those virgins rose up
But the foolish ones said to the wise,
for our lamps are being extinguished.’
dicentes: Ne forte non sufficiat nobis,
‘Lest perhaps there may not be enough for us and for you,
et vobis, ite potius ad vendentes, et emite vobis.
it would be better for you to go to the vendors and buy some for yourselves.’
But while they were going to buy it,
et quæ paratæ erant, intraverunt cum eo ad nuptias,
And those who were prepared entered with him to the wedding,
Novissime vero veniunt et reliquæ virgines,
Yet truly, at the very end, the remaining virgins also arrived,
And so you must be vigilant,
because you do not know the day
For it is like a man setting out on a long journey,
and delivered to them his goods.
And to one he gave five talents,
alii vero unum, unicuique secundum propriam virtutem:
yet to another he gave one, to each according to his own ability.
Abiit autem qui quinque talenta acceperat,
Then he who had received five talents went out,
and he made use of these,
he who had received two gained another two.
But he who had received one,
going out, dug into the earth,
and he hid the money of his lord.
Post multum vero temporis venit dominus servorum illorum, et posuit rationem cum eis.
Yet truly, after a long time, the lord of those servants returned and he settled accounts with them.
Et accedens qui quinque talenta acceperat,
And when he who had received five talents approached,
you delivered five talents to me.
Behold, I have increased it by another five.’
Since you have been faithful over a few things,
I will appoint you over many things.
Enter into the gladness of your lord.’
Then he who had received two talents also approached,
you delivered two talents to me.
Since you have been faithful over a few things,
I will appoint you over many things.
Enter into the gladness of your lord.’
Then he who had received one talent,
I know that you are a hard man.
You reap where you have not sown,
and gather where you have not scattered.
et abscondi talentum tuum in terra:
I went out and hid your talent in the earth.
Behold, you have what is yours.’
But his lord said to him in response:
et piger, sciebas quia meto ubi non semino,
You knew that I reap where I have not sown,
and gather where I have not scattered.
oportuit ergo te committere pecuniam meam numulariis,
Therefore, you should have deposited my money with the bankers, and then,
et veniens ego recepissem utique quod meum est cum usura.
at my arrival, at least I would have received what is mine with interest.
et date ei qui habet decem talenta:
take the talent away from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
For to everyone who has, more shall be given,
et abundabit: ei autem qui non habet,
and he shall have in abundance. But from him who has not,
even what he seems to have,
Et inutilem servum ejicite in tenebras exteriores:
And cast that useless servant into the outer darkness,
Cum autem venerit Filius hominis in majestate sua,
But when the Son of man will have arrived in his majesty,
and all the Angels with him,
tunc sedebit super sedem majestatis suæ:
then he will sit upon the seat of his majesty.
et congregabuntur ante eum omnes gentes,
And all the nations shall be gathered together before him.
And he shall separate them from one another,
sicut pastor segregat oves ab hædis:
just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
et statuet oves quidem a dextris suis,
And he shall station the sheep, indeed, on his right,
but the goats on his left.
Tunc dicet rex his qui a dextris ejus erunt:
Then the King shall say to those who will be on his right:
possidete paratum vobis regnum a constitutione mundi:
Possess the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
and you gave me to eat;
and you gave me to drink;
Then the just will answer him,
when have we seen you hungry,
And when have we seen you a stranger,
Or when did we see you sick,
And in response, the King shall say to them,
quamdiu fecistis uni ex his fratribus meis minimis,
whenever you did this for one of these, the least of my brothers,
Tunc dicet et his qui a sinistris erunt:
Then he shall also say, to those who will be on his left:
Discedite a me maledicti in ignem æternum,
‘Depart from me, you accursed ones, into the eternal fire,
qui paratus est diabolo, et angelis ejus:
which was prepared for the devil and his angels.
and you did not give me to eat;
and you did not give me to drink;
and you did not take me in;
and you did not cover me;
and you did not visit me.’
Then they will also answer him,
when did we see you hungry,
and did not minister to you?’
Then he shall respond to them by saying:
Quamdiu non fecistis uni de minoribus his,
whenever you did not do it to one of these least,
neither did you do it to me.’
Et ibunt hi in supplicium æternum:
And these shall go into eternal punishment,
but the just shall go into eternal life.”
